user.title: Speaker Recognition Tools
user.description: Choose which prompt addition to add. Each can be added once and selected separately in your conversation agent's LLM APIs.

user.title: Add person
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant user account that Speaker Recognition links to this voice, and the title the agent should use for them. If you leave the title blank, the first name on the account is used.

data_description.title: Optional. Leave blank to use the first name on the account.
data_description.entities: Entities that belong to this person, such as their calendars and their phone from the Companion App. The agent uses them for requests like "What's on my calendar?" or "What is Sarah doing on Friday?".

data_description.title: Optional. Leave blank to use the first name on the account.
